LESSON: MYSELF ENVIRONMENT

Grade: PP1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: SOCIAL
Topic 1.1: Myself ENVIRONMENT

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Myself ENVIRONMENT. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What is your name?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. tell their names for their names and sex identity • Learners are guided to group
2. identify their sex for themselves according to sex self-awareness • Learners are guided on picture
3. identify body parts reading categorizing boys and (head, hands and legs) girls

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: MYSELF ENVIRONMENT
This lesson teaches Myself ENVIRONMENT for PP1 ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES.

STUDY STEPS
1. tell their names for their names and sex identity • Learners are guided to group
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. identify their sex for themselves according to sex self-awareness • Learners are guided on picture
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. identify body parts reading categorizing boys and (head, hands and legs) girls
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Myself ENVIRONMENT using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Myself ENVIRONMENT above.
2. Explain Myself ENVIRONMENT to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Myself ENVIRONMENT.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Myself ENVIRONMENT with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Myself ENVIRONMENT important for a PP1 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What is your name?
2. Which are your body parts?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. tell their names for their names and sex identity • Learners are guided to group
2. identify their sex for themselves according to sex self-awareness • Learners are guided on picture
3. identify body parts reading categorizing boys and (head, hands and legs) girls

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
